status: Prespecified before formal test; gate B development only
primary_endpoints: external BER difference at common Noisy-development threshold

confidence_interval.method: paired sex-stratified speaker cluster percentile bootstrap; target/external separately
confidence_interval.multiplicity: No familywise significance claims; intervals reported as estimation, no posthoc simultaneous superiority claims

case_thresholds.representative: nearest standardized coordinate median; ClipID lexical tie

band_intervention.foreground: clean target test utterances only, no model tuning
band_intervention.filter: real zero-phase FFT magnitude, reflect pad 1 s each side, 50 Hz cosine transitions centered at interior boundaries
band_intervention.energy_matched: per utterance/level, match all bands to minimum common attainable energy loss, bisection of attenuation from 0 to level
controls: whole-signal gain matched to each fixed-band energy
whole-signal gain matched to common-energy variant
band_intervention.interpretation: fixed ECAPA response to these artificial perturbations; no claim of uniquely identifying features used by model
band_intervention.export: All perturbations and unprocessed/level controls for an utterance share one gain 0.5/max(1, max absolute sample across the entire predetermined perturbation set); no per-variant normalization. Same FLOAT/PCM24 import policy as baseline; assess on original scale.

secondary: source points and leave-one-source, class and SNR weights fixed
optional_Wiener: not in main locked comparison; if later implemented retain separate prespecified extension, frozen before its formal test; never replace main systems
